# RUUI Contributing Guide
1. It can take a lot of time to review a pull request. Please don't waste our time with low effort pr's created by AI.
2. Please do not use AI to respond to or edit pr's in response to feedback, if you need to use AI to make your change please just raise an issue requesting the feature, why its needed and how urgently its needed.
3. If the PR is clearly AI slop it will be closed and ignored.
